description: Free. Coarse pre-trade rug check for one token: a Solana mint or link, or a Robinhood Chain pons 0x address or link. Returns verdict (avoid | caution | no_flags_observed), a reason and coverage; any other Solana mint gets a thin on-chain answer, never avoid on that evidence. Not a safety verdict. Next: verdict $0.01, mint_risk_card $0.025, rhc_curve_card $0.02. Use it first before you buy.

mint.description: Alias of token, either name works: takes a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link, or a pons 0x address.

token.description: The token to check. Solana: a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link (a base58 SPL or Token-2022 mint, 32-44 chars; a link is resolved to its mint). Robinhood Chain: a pons v2 curve or token address (0x + 40 hex), or its pons link (www.ponsfamily.com/launchpad/<token>) or explorer link (robinhoodchain.blockscout.com/token/<token>).

name: token_check
title: Free pre-trade rug check (any Solana token, pons on Robinhood Chain)
